hints.title: Single Inversion Modification Disjunction
hints.text: At most one modification is permitted. When finding nums[i] greater than nums[i + 1], either nums[i] must be decreased or nums[i + 1] must be increased.

hints.title: Leftward Constraint Minimization Invariant
hints.text: If index i is 0 or nums[i - 1] is at most nums[i + 1], decreasing nums[i] to nums[i + 1] minimizes downstream values; otherwise nums[i + 1] must increase to nums[i].

hints.title: Single Modification Greedy Procedure
hints.text: Traverse the array from index 0 to length minus two. On finding nums[i] strictly greater than nums[i + 1], check if a modification was already used; if so, return false. Flag that a modification is used. If i is 0 or nums[i - 1] is at most nums[i + 1], set nums[i] to nums[i + 1]; else set nums[i + 1] to nums[i]. Return true.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every possible element removal takes quadratic O(N^2) time on arrays up to 10,000 integers.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear scan resolves the single inversion in O(N) time and requires strictly O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should compare nums[i - 1] with nums[i + 1] to decide whether to lower nums[i] or raise nums[i + 1].
